beats.care: If you're under 18, rules like this could reach India too. India's data law already needs parental consent for under-18s' data.
beats.what: Greece's Parliament passed a law banning social media for under-15s, starting January 1.
beats.why: Apps must verify users' age and will be fined if they fail. More countries are curbing young people's app use.

cards.body: The law requires age verification on social networks and penalties for companies that don't comply.

a.body: Kids need protection from addictive feeds, bullying and harmful content.
a.label: Supporters say

b.body: Teens will lie about age or use VPNs. Age checks also risk everyone's privacy.
b.label: Critics say

cards.q: Should India ban social media for under-15s?
From what age will Greek kids be allowed on social media?

hook: Greece bans social media for kids *under 15*. Should India?

learn.t: Australia was among the first countries to set a minimum social media age, of 16.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Greece passes legislation banning social media for children under 15 (print, Hyderabad edition, 24 Oct, p.14)

tldr: Greece passed a law banning social media for children under 15 from January 1, joining a growing list of countries.
watch: Watch how Greece enforces age checks from January, and whether India debates similar rules.
